name: Claude gateway
tagline: Claude Code as one shared service for your self-hosted apps.
description: A small container that runs Claude Code headless behind an internal HTTP API. Any app on your Docker host can send it a job and get text back, while Claude keeps one memory of your setup and your rules. Claude gets no shell and no access to the host.
features: POST /ask {job, input} for any app on the Docker network
One shared workspace: your rules plus Claude's own notes per job
No shell, no Docker socket, no published ports
API key or Claude subscription token
